🔥 SAN FRANCISCO, BOLLYWOOD IS TAKING OVER THIS DIWALi. 🔥

🪔 SAN FRANCISCO DIWALI FEST 2026 🪔

Music • Culture • CelebrationBolly Beats Events presents SAN FRANCISCOS’ Biggest Diwali Cultural Celebration — DIWALI FEST 2026!
One of SF's most sought-after nightlife DJs- DJ RUSH brings the DIWALI BOLLYWOOD NIGHT to Buddha Nightclub in San Francisco on Friday, November 13th.( https://www.instagram.com/djrushofficial/)

Join us on Friday, NOVEMBER 13th at BUDDA NIGHTCLUB for a spectacular evening celebrating the Festival of Lights in the heart of SAN FRANCISCO.
We’re transforming the BUDDA into a vibrant Diwali festival filled with music, culture, lights, entertainment, and incredible energy.
This is more than a party — it’s a full Diwali festival experience designed for families, friends, couples, and communities to come together and celebrate one of India’s most beautiful festivals.

✨ WHAT TO EXPECT🎶 Music Festival Stage
🎤 Live Performances & Entertainment
🎧 DJs + Bollywood Music

🎧 DJ Rush
🎶 Bollywood Beats All Night

⚠️ PLEASE NOTE: 21+ MUSIC & BAR AREA
While Diwali Dhamaka is a festival, access to the Club is strictly 21+.
Come dressed in your favorite Indian / ethnic attire and experience an evening filled with colors, music, food and the spirit of Diwali.

🌎 EVERYONE IS WELCOMEYou do not have to be Indian to attend!
Diwali Dhamaka is open to all ages, all communities, all cultures and all ethnicities. Whether you celebrate Diwali every year or this is your first time experiencing the Festival of Lights, we invite you to come celebrate with SAN FRANCISCO
